name: Elder Bloodhoof
summary: Elder Bloodhoof is an ancestral spirit found resting just north of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Appearing prominently to travelers during the Lunar Festival, he stands as a revered guardian spirit of the Bloodhoof tribe.

sections.title: Spirit of the Ancestors
sections.body: Elder Bloodhoof represents the deep spiritual bond the tauren share with their lineage. Manifesting near Bloodhoof Village, this ghostly elder watches over his people and rewards respectful travelers who seek wisdom during the Lunar Festival. His presence reinforces the enduring guidance of deceased chieftains and tribal forebears, whose spirits remain intimately tied to the plains of Mulgore.

aliases: who is the ghost outside bloodhoof village
faq.answer: Elder Bloodhoof is a ghostly tauren spirit who appears just north of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. He represents the honored ancestors of the Bloodhoof tribe, offering blessings and ancient wisdom to travelers who visit him during seasonal traditions like the Lunar Festival.

faq.q: When can you see Elder Bloodhoof?
faq.answer: Elder Bloodhoof primarily manifests during the annual Lunar Festival, where he acts as an elder spirit offering festival blessings.

faq.q: What is his connection to Bloodhoof Village?
aliases: why is he near bloodhoof village
faq.answer: As an honored ancestor bearing the clan's name, Elder Bloodhoof watches over the ancestral settlement of Bloodhoof Village. Tauren tradition places deep significance on ancestral spirits lingering close to where their descendants live and gather.

angles.text: For tauren pilgrims, paying respects to Elder Bloodhoof is a direct communion with tribal lineage, honoring the sacrifice of those who walked Mulgore long before the founding of Thunder Bluff.
Shaman revere Elder Bloodhoof as a manifestation of ancestral reverence, demonstrating how ancestral spirits guide and protect their descendants in the physical realm.
